Metadata.Goal: 将 spl-bun 的 depa ORM fixtures、code-first consumers、文档与运行集成迁移到 Kunun typed Property 唯一关系 authority。
Metadata.Description: 建立语义迁移 oracle，迁移 82 个 detached relation fixtures、同 bundle 的 typed Field profiles 和 retired code-first/deep-import consumers，增加反漂移守卫并运行完整 capsule/workspace 验证。

TaskSpace.name: migrate-orm-consumers-to-property-relations
TaskSpace.Description: 先冻结公共产物和迁移 oracle，再按 source/programmatic 两条入口迁移，最后以 guard、完整 runtime suite 和 host build 收口。

TaskGroup.name: Artifact Baseline And Migration Oracle
TaskGroup.Description: 让 host 可复现地消费新公共产物，并在修改 fixture 前记录完整 relation 语义。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: Public artifacts resolve without committed local paths or deep imports
All legacy fixture relations are represented in a deterministic inventory
Representative migrated fixtures prove the oracle and compiler path

Task.name: Rebase public package consumption
Task.Description: 临时链接或打包 sibling public artifacts，迁移 DSL deep imports 到 root，并建立不会提交绝对路径的 package resolution gate。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: The capsule and domain runtime resolve the completed Kunun/depa public JS and declarations.
Committed manifests, lockfiles, tsconfig and source contain no sibling absolute path or unexported DSL subpath.

Task.name: Freeze relation migration inventory and oracle
Task.Description: 从旧 fixtures 提取 owner/target/property/cardinality/tuple/through/options，建立 before/after catalog normalization 与 coverage test。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Every legacy relation fixture and owner edge appears exactly once in the inventory.
The oracle detects tuple order, cardinality, visibility, through and write-option drift.

Task.name: Migrate representative relation shapes
Task.Description: 先迁移 direct/inverse、hidden reverse、composite 与 many-to-many/through 代表 fixture，修正共享 helper 并验证新 compiler。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Representative source fixtures compile only through typed Properties and match the migration oracle.
Visible inverse navigation is declared and hidden reciprocal behavior remains non-navigable.

TaskGroup.name: Corpus And Code-First Migration
TaskGroup.Description: 迁移完整 source corpus、programmatic consumers、复制文档与旧 authority guards。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: No canonical fixture or consumer uses detached relation authoring
Programmatic tests construct real Kunun Property members
Focused relation, composite, read/write and cascade suites pass

Task.name: Migrate the complete source fixture graph
Task.Description: 迁移剩余 82-file graph 及同 bundle 的 typed Field object profiles，逐 bundle 校验 scalar schema、owner/inverse 唯一性、tuple、through 与 runtime options。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: All canonical Kon relation fixtures use typed Fields plus owner/inverse Properties and compile without diagnostics.
The normalized catalog inventory has no missing, duplicate or behaviorally changed edge.

Task.name: Replace retired code-first and compiler tests
Task.Description: 用 Kunun builders、metadata helper、definition compiler 与 host-owned normalization 替换 composer/workflow/snapshot/diff/parser-internal consumers。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: No runtime or test consumer imports retired CodeFirstOrm APIs or unexported DSL subpaths.
Source and programmatic definitions remain behaviorally equivalent for direct, inverse, composite and through cases.

Task.name: Align canonical docs and anti-drift guards
Task.Description: 同步 property-first DSL bundle，扩展 architecture/schema guard；负例 marker 必须显式 allowlist。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Copied canonical docs describe only typed Property relation authoring.
Guards reject detached syntax, Field-owned relation metadata, retired code-first APIs and DSL deep imports.

TaskGroup.name: Host Integration And Verification
TaskGroup.Description: 验证完整 capsule、domain runtime/workbench、workspace build 和 package authority。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: Complete capsule suite passes against the property-first public artifacts
Domain runtime and workbench flows preserve their behavior
Repository-wide authority and package boundary checks pass

Task.name: Verify focused relation runtime behavior
Task.Description: 运行 derivation、composite、through、nested read/write、cascade、eager loading 和 package-boundary focused suites。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Focused runtime suites preserve all modeled relation behaviors.
Negative authority cases fail closed with current public diagnostics.

Task.name: Run complete host gates and handoff
Task.Description: 运行 capsule full suite、domain package tests、workspace typecheck/build、workbench flow checks、strict Codument 与 diff checks，记录可复现 handoff。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: The complete capsule, runtime, bundle, server and workbench test surfaces pass.
Workspace typecheck/build and repository guards pass with no committed local dependency escape.
The verification report records artifact identities, commands and any non-blocking residual risk.
